name: reset-preview
title: Reset Preview
description: Reset-to-defaults preview listing only the settings the user changed as current → default, with per-setting keep checkboxes, an export nudge until a copy is saved, and a draining Undo after the reset.

meta.summary: Shows only the settings a reset would actually change, current → default, so a reset to defaults doesn't wipe customisations unseen.
catches: Customised settings that a reset would change, grouped by section
Settings to keep, excluded from the reset
No export saved yet, with a one-tap export
Settings already at default, counted rather than listed
Reset regret, with a timed Undo
limits: Undo relies on your onUndo and lasts undoFor ms
Value display uses a simple formatter; pass format for complex values
a11y: Preview is a group labelled by its title; each section has an aria-label
Keep checkboxes have descriptive aria-labels; arrow icon has an aria-label ("resets to")
Export warning in a polite live region; reset button sets aria-busy while pending
After reset, a role=status message with Undo
